summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report) carrying a Regulatory News Service announcement of open-market purchases under its existing share buyback programme, announced 31 July 2026, executed through broker Goldman Sachs International. Over 2–6 November 2026 the company bought roughly 139.1 million ordinary shares at volume-weighted prices of 94.81–98.57 pence, with daily ranges spanning 93.70–99.80 pence. All shares will be cancelled, reducing share count. Disclosure follows UK MAR Article 5(1)(b) with a full trade schedule; watch daily execution pace and cancellation updates.
